name: Co-Pilot
source:
The job of a pilot is taxing; non-stop work, hyper-specific scheduling, with only soulless computer screens for company. In order to help Pilot cope, her mind is split into two. Maybe she can keep herself company.

[From [url=https://90percentstudios.itch.io/co-pilot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
飞行员的工作很繁重；不间断的工作，高度具体的日程安排，只有毫无灵魂的电脑屏幕陪伴。为了帮助派洛特应对，她的思想一分为二。也许她可以陪伴自己。

[来自[url=https://90percentstudios.itch.io/co-pilot]itch.io[/url]]
